crossRefs.note: For we know that the law is spiritual, but I am fleshly, sold under sin.
Do we then nullify the law through faith? May it never be! No, we establish the law.
Don’t be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may prove what is the…
What great nation is there that has statutes and ordinances so righteous as all this law which I set before you today?
Now, Israel, what does Yahweh your God require of you, but to fear Yahweh your God, to walk in all his ways, to love…
“You also came down on Mount Sinai, and spoke with them from heaven, and gave them right ordinances and true laws, good…
Yahweh’s law is perfect, restoring the soul. Yahweh’s covenant is sure, making wise the simple.
Fulfill your promise to your servant, that you may be feared.
All of your commandments are faithful. They persecute me wrongfully. Help me!
Therefore I love your commandments more than gold, yes, more than pure gold.
You are righteous, Yahweh. Your judgments are upright.
Your promises have been thoroughly tested, and your servant loves them.
Let my tongue sing of your word, for all your commandments are righteousness.
But we know that the law is good, if a person uses it lawfully,
What shall we say then? Is the law sin? May it never be! However, I wouldn’t have known sin, except through the law.…

translations.web: Therefore the law indeed is holy, and the commandment holy, and righteous, and good.
translations.bsb: So then, the law is holy, and the commandment is holy, righteous, and good.
translations.kjv: Wherefore the law is holy, and the commandment holy, and just, and good.
translations.asv: So that the law is holy, and the commandment holy, and righteous, and good.
